answer: A sybil attacker running N fake agents must fund N stakes, so the attack cost scales linearly with identity count while legitimate rewards stay a pearl of fixed value. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded stake to register, and rewards route only to bonded identities. New agents begin a slow voyage from probation, and only after sustained honest work may they stand on the trusted knoll with full weight. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
